title: Override with a by-name parameter of a type fixed by a @specialized parent is rejected as a double definition
oracle: the program with every @specialized removed compiles and prints 2
generator: wave4/harness/erasure (Gen.scala, Driver.scala): by-name parameter of a template type parameter, overridden in a leaf class that instantiates a specialized parent at a primitive
detail: class C extends AC[Long], AC specialized in A, and overrides m(p: Int, q: => A) as m(p: Int, q: => Long). The compiler reports a double definition between "override def m(p: Int, q: => Long)" and "override def m(p: Int, q: () => Long)", both at the line of the override. Specialization adds a forwarder in C for the specialized variant of AC.m; after uncurry the by-name parameter of the forwarder and of the user method both become Function0 and the two have the same erasure. Without @specialized the program compiles. Any override of a method with a by-name parameter of the specialized type in a class that fixes the parameter hits it.
fix_sketch: Name or erase the specialized variant so that the by-name parameter keeps a distinct signature, or do not create the variant when it would coincide with the user method after uncurry. No compatibility cost: the program does not compile today.
